goal: Wave 3 build: Knowledge and connector sources in deep research; suggest_connector tool, connector_suggestion event and card (Ask loop); Resumable connect intent (SPA only); Network boundary and allow-list proxy; Share snapshots: store, RPCs and routes (dark); Import a thread export (untrusted input) NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations: numbers must apply IN ORDER, so always take the next number above the highest file in the migrations folder (0111 exists; 0106 was reserved for EP-12-S14 but is below the highest, so EP-12-S14 takes 0112 or the next above the highest), never a lower reserved round-B number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object. auth-core has ONE ApiKeyExchangeController serving every audience (merged from main 2026-11-04): extend it, never add a second exchange route.

slices.title: Network boundary and allow-list proxy
slices.summary: Makes bwrap always unshare the net namespace and gives tiered calls a per-call Unix-socket CONNECT proxy (egress_proxy.rs, with its own DNS guard refusing private/loopback/link-local/metadata addresses) bridged to 127.0.0.1:3128 by a small mp-netbridge binary; the executor checks the live proxy instead of HTTPS_PROXY. Tier comes from min(lease tier, run tier) and is forced off for ZDR, waived, plan-mode, tainted and locked-down runs; E1's report carries tier and allowed/denied counts. Final numbers: sandbox-manager migration 0008_lease_egress_tier; sandboxes.proto AcquireLeaseResponse.egress_tier = 7 plus enum SandboxEgressTier; sandbox-manager grants the lease at off instead of refusing (D-E2). ZDR golden rows e_sandbox_egress_refused_under_zdr, e_sandbox_egress_refused_for_waived_run and feature sandbox_egress added, with regenerated sha and FE copy. Second flag SANDBOX_MANAGER_EGRESS_TIERS (sandbox-manager, default false).
slices.remaining: D-E2 (owner acknowledges amending ledger rule at ledger.md:4440-4450: grant the lease at off and record the permitted tier instead of refusing an egress-capable claim); D-E1 (netns plus socket-bridged proxy) accepted as recommendation per round B. [Decisions taken 2026-11-04 at the recommended option (owner).]
